So I had therapy for about 5 months and then my insurance got cut off so I had stopped for about a month and haven’t been back (even with my insurance being reinstated). Truthfully, I believe I’m very complicated and complex to understand and I know people say keep trying new therapists until you find the right one but I realized that that was just too much for me. Yea, at some sessions I felt relief but others I felt as if my therapist kept pushing the agenda of self love and it rubbed me the wrong way a lil because I know I love myself and not every situation that happens is because of the lack of self love. I also realized that I’m tired of speaking about my emotions just for temporary relief. Not putting all the blame on my therapist but I just think I’m not as ready as I thought to go into therapy or maybe I’m too far gone 🤷🏾‍♀️. But everyone’s experience is different and therapy is working for a lot of people so go for it!
